# PilotAssessments.com

> > Comprehensive pilot assessment preparation platform offering psychometric testing, interview training, and airline-specific exam prep for aspiring commercial pilots.

PilotAssessments.com provides PASS, an integrated platform for preparing for pilot recruitment assessments across major airlines including Emirates, Wizz Air, Aer Lingus, and Norwegian Air Shuttle. The platform combines psychometric testing (Cut-E, AON, COMPASS), simulator training, ATPL preparation, and interview coaching through multiple subscription tiers and enterprise solutions for flight schools and ATOs.

## Core Platform & Products

- [PilotAssessments.com Homepage](https://pilotassessments.com): Main entry point for PASS pilot assessment prep platform covering AON, Cut-E, COMPASS tests
- [Pilot Assessments](https://pilotassessments.com/pilot-assessments): Product overview showcasing PASS Basic, Advanced, and Professional subscription packages
- [About PASS](https://pilotassessments.com/about-pass): Platform overview covering psychometric tests, ADAPT integration, and comprehensive airline training resources
- [PASS Features](https://pilotassessments.com/features): Feature overview including progress tracking, interview training, ATPL preparation, and study tools
- [ADAPT by Symbiotics](https://pilotassessments.com/adapt-by-symbiotics): Symbiotics ADAPT system integration with FAST test and advanced aptitude testing capabilities
- [PASS Login](https://pilotassessments.com/pass): Platform login portal with Google and Facebook social authentication options

## Airline-Specific Assessment Guides

- [Wizz Air Pilot Assessment](https://pilotassessments.com/wizz-air-pilot-assessment): Wizz Air assessment prep guide covering FAST Test, A320 training, and cadet program preparation
- [Emirates Pilot Assessment](https://pilotassessments.com/emirates-pilot-assessment): Emirates recruitment assessment prep with HireVue, Saville, COMPASS tests and MS Teams interview training
- [Aer Lingus Pilot Assessment](https://pilotassessments.com/aer-lingus-pilot-assessment): Aer Lingus assessment guide featuring Cut-E and AON psychometric tests with A320 simulator training
- [Norwegian Air Shuttle Pilot Assessment](https://pilotassessments.com/norwegian-air-shuttle-pilot-assessment): Norwegian Air Shuttle recruitment prep focused on Boeing 737-800 pilot assessment requirements
- [TUI Pilot Assessment](https://pilotassessments.com/tui-fly-netherlands-pilot-assessment): TUI airline assessment preparation covering Netherlands, Belgium, UK, and Nordic regional operations
- [Air Atlanta Icelandic Pilot Assessment](https://pilotassessments.com/air-atlanta-icelandic-pilot-assessment): Air Atlanta Icelandic assessment guide for Boeing 747 cargo pilot position recruitment

## Business Solutions & Partnerships

- [PASS for Flight Schools and ATOs](https://pilotassessments.com/pass-for-flight-schools-and-atos): Enterprise PASS Business solution designed for flight schools and approved training organizations
- [Become A Partner](https://pilotassessments.com/become-a-partner): Partnership and affiliate program page for aviation industry collaborators and training organizations
